summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a September 22, 2026 Master Services Agreement with Factor Bioscience Inc., under which Factor provides research and development services via mutually agreed work orders, plus Work Order No. 1 covering in vivo CAR-T development. The MSA ties to an Amended and Restated License and Collaboration Agreement with Factor Bioscience Limited dated November 19, 2025 and effective August 6, 2025. Termination requires 30 days' notice; Tempest may suspend Work Order No. 1 up to three times. CEO Matt Angel, owning 34.2% of Tempest and controlling Factor, makes this a related-person transaction reviewed by the Board and Audit Committee. This is a routine services contract, not a special situation; watch related-party governance scrutiny.
